content.overview: A charge created by a company must be registered under s. 77 or it is void against the liquidator and creditors.
content.glance: A charge created by a company must be registered under s. 77 or it is void against the liquidator and creditors.
content.study: Registration of charges. A charge created by a company must be registered under s. 77 or it is void against the liquidator and creditors. The section applies only to the persons, companies, and transactions it names. A filing, approval, or penalty arises only where the section or a rule under it says so. It does not create a power that is reserved to another section or to the Tribunal. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Principle
sections.body: A charge created by a company must be registered under s. 77 or it is void against the liquidator and creditors.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Time, extension, holder application under s. 78, constructive notice under s. 80, satisfaction under s. 82, and rectification under s. 87 form the scheme. Non-registration does not extinguish the debt.

sections.heading: Ingredients
sections.body: Charge; Timely filing; Effect of omission; Satisfaction entry
